services.name: Bike n' Hike to Liffy
services.desc: Take on a fun adventure with a Bike n' Hike tour to Liffy Island. Duration This is about an 5-mile round trip tour. This is a guided tour for road safety on back roads and roads that share the way with cars. It is a little hilly, but these bikes make it easy to get up any hill. Call 973-663-1944 with ANY questions. About About an 5-mile round trip adventure. We'll take the back roads from LHAC to Prospect Point, pick up the trail to the new bridge to Liffy. It's a short hike around the island to the banks of the lake for a quick snack.
